ns2:section.sectionText: Topic: Questions of Difference: Problems in Global South Photography. Why are studies and exhibitions of Global South photography so popular today? What are the ideological underpinnings of the "global turn" in the history of photography? What is the relationship between photographic discourse and the colonial, postcolonial, or neocolonial condition? This seminar investigates these and related questions by focusing on recent scholarship of photography in Africa, the African Diaspora, Latin America, and Asia.
